title: Why Do Pull Requests Go Silent? Uncovering the Barriers to Contribution Completion in Open-Source Code Review
abstract: arXiv:2609.22625v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pull requests (PRs) underpin pull-based software development by enabling distributed code review and collaborative contribution in open-source projects. Yet many become inactive before integration and are eventually abandoned or closed, wasting contributor and maintainer effort. Although prior work has examined PR abandonment and review delays, less is known about the contribution types, discussion-level barriers, and post-stalling collaboration patterns associated with inactivity. We investigate which PR types most often stall, why inactivity occurs from authors' and reviewers' perspectives, and how stalling relates to later contributor and reviewer engagement. We analyzed 14,234 stalled PRs and 164,562 review comments from 19 popular GitHub repositories using stale-bot workflows. translated_title: 为什么拉取请求会陷入沉寂？揭示开源代码评审中贡献完成的障碍
translated_abstract: 拉取请求是拉取式软件开发的基础，它使开源项目中的分布式代码评审和协作贡献成为可能。然而，许多拉取请求在合并之前就变得不活跃，最终被放弃或关闭，浪费了贡献者和维护者的精力。尽管先前的研究已经考察了拉取请求的放弃和评审延迟，但对于与不活跃相关的贡献类型、讨论层面的障碍以及停滞后的协作模式，人们知之甚少。我们研究了哪些类型的拉取请求最容易停滞，从作者和评审者的视角分析不活跃发生的原因，以及停滞与后续贡献者和评审者参与之间的关系。我们分析了来自19个使用stale-bot工作流的热门GitHub仓库的14,234个停滞的拉取请求和164,562条评审评论。基于大语言模型的投票分类器按贡献类型对拉取请求进行分类，同时将定量分析与对一般评论和行内评论的定性编码相结合……
tldr: 该研究通过分析19个热门GitHub仓库中14,234个停滞的拉取请求及其评审评论，首次从贡献类型、讨论层面障碍和停滞后的协作模式三个维度，系统揭示了开源代码评审中拉取请求失去活跃度的原因及其对后续贡献参与的影响。
en_tdlr: This study analyzes 14,234 stalled pull requests and their review comments from 19 popular GitHub repositories, systematically uncovering which PR types most often stall, the discussion-level barriers behind inactivity, and how stalling relates to subsequent contributor and reviewer engagement.
